info.title: Geoapify MCP API
info.description: Compact catalog for the Geoapify Model Context Protocol JSON-RPC endpoint. Use the linked focused specifications for complete tool output contracts and additional examples.

servers.description: EU-focused endpoint. Geoapify service processing uses EU infrastructure.

post.summary: Call the Geoapify MCP JSON-RPC endpoint
post.description: Send MCP initialize, tools/list, tools/call, or notification JSON-RPC requests. Tool execution and validation failures return HTTP 200 with result.isError set to true; transport, authentication, quota, and gateway failures use HTTP error statuses.

parameters.name: MCP-Protocol-Version
parameters.description: Optional protocol version. Defaults to 2025-06-18 when omitted; explicitly unsupported versions are rejected.

toolsList.description: Default request body. Returns the tools and input schemas exposed by the Geoapify MCP endpoint.

initialize.description: Initialize an MCP client session and read server capabilities.

geocodeAddressBerlin.description: Convert a free-text address or place query into coordinates and structured address data.

geocodeStructuredAddressStreet.description: Geocode structured address fields into coordinates and normalized address data.

reverseGeocodeBerlin.description: Convert latitude and longitude coordinates into nearby address or place data.

searchPlacesRestaurants.description: Find places and points of interest by category near geographic coordinates.

listPlaceCategoriesNumericId.description: List the category values accepted by search_places.

calculateRouteDrive.description: Calculate a route between geographic waypoints for a supported travel mode.

calculateRouteMatrixSymmetric.description: Calculate travel times and distances between source and target locations.

relationContains.summary: Geometry: check whether a polygon contains a point

notificationsInitialized.description: Send an MCP initialized notification. Notifications do not include a JSON-RPC id.

200.description: JSON-RPC response for initialize, tools/list, and tools/call requests, including tool failures with result.isError set to true.

geocodeAddressValidationError.description: Tool argument errors are MCP results with HTTP 200 and isError set to true.

unknownTool.description: An unknown tool name is returned as a JSON-RPC invalid-params error with HTTP 200.

202.description: Accepted notification request with no JSON-RPC response body.

400.description: Invalid HTTP request or unsupported MCP protocol version. Tool validation errors are returned with HTTP 200 and result.isError set to true.

401.description: Missing or invalid Geoapify API key.

example.message: Request failed, please try again later

JsonRpcId.description: JSON-RPC request identifier. The server echoes this value in the response.

InitializeRequest.description: JSON-RPC request that initializes an MCP client session.

id.description: Client-supplied JSON-RPC request id echoed in the response.

params.description: Optional MCP initialize parameters supplied by the client.

ToolsListRequest.description: JSON-RPC request that lists available MCP tools and their input schemas.

id.description: Client-supplied JSON-RPC request id echoed in the response.

NotificationRequest.description: JSON-RPC notification request. Notifications do not receive a JSON-RPC response and must not include id.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code, such as -32600 for an invalid request, -32601 for an unknown method, or -32602 for invalid parameters.

JsonRpcErrorResponse.description: JSON-RPC error response returned for invalid requests or unknown methods.

ToolMetadata.description: MCP tool metadata returned by tools/list.

ToolCallResponse.description: Successful JSON-RPC response for tools/call. Tool failures are returned with isError set to true.

content.description: Text representation of the structured result or error.

text.description: JSON-encoded tool result or GatewayError object.

waypoints.description: Ordered route waypoints. Provide at least an origin and destination.

mode.description: Travel or vehicle mode used to calculate the route.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. Supported values are "tolls", "ferries", and "highways".

geometry_scope.description: Geometry detail to return: none, route only, route and legs, or route, legs, and instruction steps.

geometry_format.description: Return geometry as a GeoJSON geometry object or an encoded precision-5 polyline.

optimize_stops.description: Optimize the order of intermediate stops while preserving the first and last waypoint.

traffic.description: Traffic model used for motorized routing.

CombineGeometriesIntersectionInput.title: intersection
CombineGeometriesIntersectionInput.description: Return the area shared by all input polygons.

operation.description: Return the area shared by all input polygons.

items.description: GeoJSON Geometry (Polygon, or MultiPolygon); not a Feature or FeatureCollection.

CombineGeometriesIntersectionOutput.description: Returns `{ "type": "geojson", "data": Feature }` for the shared Polygon or MultiPolygon area, or `{ "type": "empty", "data": null }` when the inputs have no shared area.

CombineGeometriesDifferenceInput.title: difference
CombineGeometriesDifferenceInput.description: Subtract every later polygon from the first polygon.

operation.description: Subtract every later polygon from the first polygon.

items.description: GeoJSON Geometry (Polygon, or MultiPolygon); not a Feature or FeatureCollection.

geometries.description: Ordered polygons. Every geometry after the first is subtracted from the first.

CombineGeometriesDifferenceOutput.description: Returns `{ "type": "geojson", "data": Feature }` for the part of the first Polygon or MultiPolygon that remains, or `{ "type": "empty", "data": null }` when nothing remains.

CombineGeometriesUnionInput.title: union
CombineGeometriesUnionInput.description: Merge two or more polygons into their geometric union.

operation.description: Merge two or more polygons into their geometric union.

items.description: GeoJSON Geometry (Polygon, or MultiPolygon); not a Feature or FeatureCollection.

CombineGeometriesUnionOutput.description: Returns `{ "type": "geojson", "data": Feature }` containing the merged Polygon or MultiPolygon.

CombineGeometriesEnvelopeInput.title: envelope
CombineGeometriesEnvelopeInput.description: Return a rectangular envelope containing all input geometries.

operation.description: Return a rectangular envelope containing all input geometries.

items.description: GeoJSON Geometry (Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, or MultiPolygon); not a Feature or FeatureCollection.

CombineGeometriesEnvelopeOutput.description: Returns `{ "type": "geojson", "data": Feature }` containing the rectangular Polygon that encloses all input geometries.

CombineGeometriesInput.description: Choose one combination operation. Each branch lists the exact accepted geometry types and limits.

arguments.description: Arguments validated by the combine_geometries input schema.

CombineGeometriesToolCallRequest.description: JSON-RPC tools/call request for the combine_geometries MCP tool.

method.description: MCP method used to call a tool.

EvaluateSpatialRelationContainsInput.title: contains
EvaluateSpatialRelationContainsInput.description: Return true when geometry contains other_geometry.

operation.description: Return true when geometry contains other_geometry.

geometry.description: Subject operand; GeoJSON Geometry (Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, or MultiPolygon); not a Feature or FeatureCollection. Operand order is significant.

other_geometry.description: Comparison operand; GeoJSON Geometry (Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, or MultiPolygon); not a Feature or FeatureCollection.

EvaluateSpatialRelationContainsOutput.description: Returns `{ "type": "boolean", "data": boolean }`; `data` is `true` when `geometry` contains `other_geometry`, and `false` otherwise.

operation.description: Return true when the geometries cross one another.

geometry.description: Subject operand; GeoJSON Geometry (Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, or MultiPolygon); not a Feature or FeatureCollection. Operand order is significant.

other_geometry.description: Comparison operand; GeoJSON Geometry (Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, or MultiPolygon); not a Feature or FeatureCollection.

EvaluateSpatialRelationCrossesOutput.description: Returns `{ "type": "boolean", "data": boolean }`; `data` is `true` when the two geometries cross, and `false` otherwise.

MeasureGeometryAreaInput.title: area

MeasureGeometryDistanceInput.title: distance
MeasureGeometryDistanceInput.description: Calculate the distance between two points.

operation.description: Calculate the distance between two points.

geometry.description: First point; GeoJSON Geometry (Point); not a Feature or FeatureCollection.

other_geometry.description: Second point; GeoJSON Geometry (Point); not a Feature or FeatureCollection.

units.description: Units for the distance or length. Defaults to kilometers.

operation.description: Calculate LineString or MultiLineString length.

units.description: Units for the distance or length. Defaults to kilometers.

operation.description: Calculate a rectangular bounding-box Feature.

geometry.description: GeoJSON Geometry (Point, LineString, Polygon, MultiPoint, MultiLineString, or MultiPolygon); not a Feature or FeatureCollection.

recompute.description: Ignore a pre-existing bbox and recompute bounds from coordinates.

MeasureGeometryBboxOutput.description: Returns `{ "type": "geojson", "data": Feature }`; `data` is a rectangular Polygon Feature whose `properties.bbox` contains `[west, south, east, north]`.
